name: Can I exchange an investment property in Miami-Dade for one in Collier County?

mainEntity.name: Can I exchange an investment property in Miami-Dade for one in Collier County?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, you can exchange an investment property located in Miami-Dade County for one in Collier County, provided both are considered 'like-kind' real estate held for investment or productive use in a trade or business. The location within the United States generally does not affect the 'like-kind' determination. The crucial factor is that both properties are investment real estate. Kelby Contreras assists clients with exchanges between any of the areas served, including Miami-Dade, Broward, Palm Beach, Collier, and Orange Counties, ensuring seamless transitions across different Florida markets.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, exchanging investment properties between different Florida counties like Miami-Dade and Collier is permissible, as 'like-kind' status is based on property type (investment real estate), not geographic location.
